info.title: AL-Go for GitHub Control CLI
info.description: CLI for controlling AL-Go for GitHub repositories

commands.name: createrelease
commands.description:
Run the AL-Go CreateRelease workflow to create a release
--version, -v    Show the algoctl version
--help, -h       Show this help

options.name: --repo
options.description:
The repository to create the release in. Short form
defaults to github.com. (required)

options.name: --ghuser
options.description:
GitHub CLI account to use for running the workflow.
Default: the active account on the target host.

options.name: --branch
options.description:
Branch (ref) to run the workflow on.
Default: the repository's default branch.

options.name: --name
options.description: Name of this release. (required)

options.name: --tag
options.description:
Tag of this release; must be a semantic version
string (https://semver.org, e.g. 1.0.0). A pattern
ending in '*' (e.g. 1.0.*) resolves to the latest
matching tag with its patch incremented, or the
first one (e.g. 1.0.0) when none exist. (required)

options.name: --buildversion
options.description:
Build version to promote to release.
Default: latest

options.name: --releasetype
options.description: Release, prerelease or draft? Default: Release

options.name: --createreleasebranch
options.description: Create a release branch. Default: false

options.name: --releasebranchprefix
options.description:
Prefix for the release branch. Used only if
--createreleasebranch is set. Default: release/

options.name: --updateversionnumber
options.description:
New version number in the main branch. Use
Major.Minor (optionally add .Build for versioning
strategy 3) for an absolute change, or +1, +0.1
(or +0.0.1 for versioning strategy 3) for an
incremental change. Default: (none)

options.name: --skipupdatingdependencies
options.description:
Skip updating dependency version numbers in all
apps. Default: false

options.name: --directcommit
options.description: Direct commit? Default: false

options.name: --useghtokenworkflow
options.description: Use GhTokenWorkflow for PR/commit? Default: false

options.name: --confirm
options.description: Skip the interactive confirmation prompt.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help.

commands.name: createrepo
commands.description: Create a new repository from a template repository

options.name: --templaterepo
options.description:
Template repository to copy content from.
Short form (owner/repo) defaults to github.com;
a full URL may target a GitHub Enterprise host.
Default: https://github.com/Freddy-DK/AL-Go-PTE

options.name: --templateghuser
options.description:
GitHub CLI account to use for reading the
template repository. Default: the active account
on the template host, or unauthenticated if none.

options.name: --repo
options.description:
The repository to create. Short form defaults
to github.com. (required)

options.name: --ghuser
options.description:
GitHub CLI account to use for creating the
repository. Default: the active account on the
target host.

options.name: --visibility
options.description:
Visibility of the new repository.
Default: private

options.name: --confirm
options.description: Skip the interactive confirmation prompt.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help.

commands.name: updaterepo
commands.description: Update an existing repository's AL-Go system-file workflow and run it

options.name: --templaterepo
options.description:
Template repository to copy the workflow from.
Short form (owner/repo) defaults to github.com;
a full URL may target a GitHub Enterprise host.
Default: https://github.com/Freddy-DK/AL-Go-PTE

options.name: --templateghuser
options.description:
GitHub CLI account to use for reading the
template repository. Default: the active account
on the template host, or unauthenticated if none.

options.name: --repo
options.description:
The repository to update. Short form defaults
to github.com. (required)

options.name: --ghuser
options.description:
GitHub CLI account to use for updating the
repository. Default: the active account on the
target host.

options.name: --branches
options.description:
Comma-separated list of branches to update, passed
to the workflow's includeBranches input. Wildcards
are supported. Default: main

options.description: Skip the interactive confirmation prompt.
